categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) fibers and their composite materials. Its product portfolio includes fine denier fibers, ultra-high strength fibers for ballistic applications, creep-resistant fibers, and ballistic and stab-resistant non-woven fabrics. The company also produces related protective equipment such as bulletproof vests, helmets, and armor plates. It has a full industry chain layout from fiber production to composite materials and finished protective products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies including high-spinnability melt single-filament fine denier spinning, in-line modification of UHMWPE fibers, original liquid dyeing, cut-resistant fiber production, and high-strength fibers for ballistic protection. It employs gel spinning technology and advanced composite material fabrication techniques for lightweight armor plates and ballistic helmets. The production process is highly automated and digitized, with strict quality control and full lifecycle traceability. The company also focuses on solvent recovery and green production technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in military equipment, public security, aerospace, marine engineering, and safety protection sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products widely recognized in defense, police, and high-end industrial applications. It also targets emerging markets such as medical fibers, sports equipment, and robotics (e.g., dexterous robotic hands). The company maintains stable relationships with major strategic customers and participates actively in industry exhibitions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Beijing, Shandong, and other locations. It serves both domestic and overseas markets, with export sales accounting for a significant portion of revenue. The company’s products are distributed internationally, and it actively participates in global market development, especially in military and high-performance fiber sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the full supply chain from upstream raw material processing (UHMWPE fiber production) through midstream composite material manufacturing to downstream finished protective products. It controls key production stages including fiber spinning, fabric production, and composite armor fabrication, positioning itself as an integrated supplier in the high-performance fiber and composite materials industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on high-performance, multifunctional, and green UHMWPE fibers and composites. R&D priorities include ultra-fine denier fibers, ultra-high strength fibers, creep resistance, lightweight and multifunctional ballistic materials, and medical fiber applications. The company invests heavily in digitalization of production, solvent recovery, and sustainable manufacturing. It also pursues strategic acquisitions to expand into related fiber sectors such as aramid fibers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of UHMWPE fibers and composite materials to industrial manufacturers and end-users in defense and safety sectors. The company uses a direct sales model, securing orders via bidding and commercial negotiations. It also earns income from related services including customized production and full lifecycle customer support. Export sales contribute significantly to total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the UHMWPE fiber industry, recognized as one of the earliest and few enterprises in China capable of large-scale production of UHMWPE fibers and composites. It holds a strong market position with advanced technology and product quality comparable to international peers. The industry is competitive with rapid capacity expansion by domestic firms, but the company maintains advantages through technology, product differentiation, and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 649 million, a 1.41% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 130 million, a 15.25% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 1.57 billion with equity of RMB 1.34 billion. The company’s R&D investment accounted for over 6% of revenue, reflecting sustained growth and innovation focus. Cash flow from operations improved significantly, supporting ongoing capital expenditures and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality UHMWPE fibers and composites with superior mechanical properties such as ultra-high strength, creep resistance, and lightweight ballistic protection. Its products meet stringent military and industrial standards and are customizable to client specifications. The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive industry chain integration, flexible production capabilities, and strong R&D-driven innovation, enabling it to serve high-end markets with reliable, high-performance materials.
